name: Tupungato
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A wine area in Valle de Uco, in Mendoza, the province that makes nearly two-thirds of Argentina's wine, with El Peral inside. Malbec leads plantings at 47%, followed by Chardonnay (11%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (9%).
